title: LEVEL 4: "NEARLY NATURAL"
body:
This is the most powerful, effective, skilled and advanced Collagen Induction Therapy we offer.
Firstly, your phlebotomy-trained clinician will take 2 blood samples.

These samples are placed in a centrifuge to separate the blood plasma (yellow) contaning natural growth factors (NGFs) from the red blood cells.

A dose of BTox is added to one syringe, and this vial is micro-needled into the surface of your skin for a glass-like effect. As you can imagine, the Btox penetrates the superficial layers of the skin producing a "glass-like" effect whilst the NGFs work to rejuvenate the skin). 

Btox is treating the skin, not the muscles beneath as you would in a traditional Btox treatment.

Fine lines soften, skin is strengthened, cells are fed an optimal cocktail of your body's natural platelet rich plasma, plus a little help is given by the Btox, hence the "Nearly Natural" name!

Finally, we mix the second vial of your blood plasma with the tried & tested JALUPRO© Injectable Moisturiser. This contains hyaluronic acid and amino acids for deep hydration and skin rejuvenation. 

We inject this using a very fine, painless needle all over the face, to provide the skin with all the nutrients it needs to flourish.

This is the best C.I.T. we offer.

title: What is Sculptra / PLLA?
body:
PLLA (Poly-L-Lactic Acid) is a unique, biocompatible substance that stimulates your body's natural collagen production. 

Unlike traditional fillers, PLLA offers a gradual, long-term enhancement, focusing on improving skin quality and creating soft, natural-looking volume in areas such as the cheek hollows and temples.

title: How Does Sculptra / PLLA Work?
body:
Once injected into the skin, PLLA stimulates collagen production over time, gradually improving skin thickness and texture. This process helps fill out hollow areas and softens fine lines. 

Results appear naturally over a few months, providing a more youthful appearance without the dramatic effects of traditional dermal fillers. We use brands Sculptra & AesPLLA (supliment charge for Sculptra).

title: Areas We Treat with PLLA
body:
Cheek Hollows: Restore lost volume and enhance your natural contours with subtle, gradual fullness in the cheek area.

Temples: Smooth out hollowed temples, creating a softer transition between the forehead and cheeks for a rejuvenated look.

Other depressions, such as those around the lower side of the mouth, jawline, nose to mouth lines and so on.

We do not treat directly around the eyes, forehead, or the upper lip. Treating these areas can lead to negative results and complications.

PLLA is an excellent option if you’re looking to enhance your facial contours gradually and improve skin texture.

title: What Is PLLA?
body:
PLLA is a collagen-stimulating treatment used to gradually improve skin firmness, structure, and volume. Rather than creating an instant heavy fill, it works by encouraging your body to rebuild its own collagen over time.

This makes it a great option for patients wanting a more natural, progressive result. It can help restore support to the face and improve overall skin quality, with results that continue to develop in the weeks and months after treatment.

title: What Are Polynucleotides?
body:
Polynucleotides are an injectable skin treatment designed to improve skin quality, hydration, and repair. They work by supporting tissue regeneration and encouraging the skin to heal and function more effectively.

This makes them ideal for patients wanting healthier, fresher-looking skin rather than added volume. They’re especially popular in delicate areas such as the under-eyes, where improving texture and skin strength can make a visible difference on dark circles over time.

title: Resurfacing Chemical Peels
body:
A resurfacing chemical peel works by removing damaged outer layers of skin to reveal a fresher, smoother, more even-looking surface underneath. It can help improve concerns such as pigmentation, dullness, fine lines, acne scarring, and uneven texture.

We offer both medium and deeper resurfacing peels, with deeper treatments giving the most dramatic level of renewal. Recovery is naturally more involved with stronger peels, but for the right patient they can produce some of the most impressive skin-refining results available without surgery.

title: What Is Subcision?
body:
Subcision is a treatment used to release the fibrous bands beneath the skin that pull acne scars or areas of tethering downwards. By freeing these attachments, the skin is able to lift and smooth more naturally from within.

The procedure is carried out under local anaesthetic, making it a very manageable and comfortable treatment for most patients. It can be especially effective for deeper, bound-down scarring and is often combined with other treatments for even better overall improvement.

body:

It can also happen when volume is placed in the wrong areas, creating a look that feels unbalanced or disconnected from the rest of the face.

The quality of the filler itself also matters, as unsuitable products can sometimes feel firm, uneven, or lumpy. At our clinic, lip enhancement is approached with precision and restraint, so the result looks soft, balanced, and in harmony with your natural features.

title: Skin Booster vs Filler
body:
Skin boosters and filler are both injectable treatments, but they do very different jobs. Filler is used to create shape, structure, and volume, whereas skin boosters are designed to improve hydration, skin quality, and overall freshness.

In simple terms, fillers enhance contour, while skin boosters improve the condition of the skin itself. Choosing the right treatment depends on whether the goal is facial shaping or healthier, glowier skin.

title: Recovery & Downtime
body:
Recovery is usually very manageable, though it varies from person to person.

There is always a risk of bruising with dermal filler. Some clients get none at all, some may get one or two small bruises, and more significant bruising is less common. Age, natural healing response, and medications such as aspirin or blood thinners can all affect how long bruising lasts.

Some swelling is also normal, especially in the first week. Most clients feel comfortable returning to work within 1–2 days, though the face can continue to settle and refine over the course of a month.
parentNamesRaw: Non-Surgical Facelift (Dermal Filler + B'Tox)

title: What is the masseter?
body:
The masseter is one of the main chewing muscles, with the bulk of the body sitting at the angle of the jaw on each side of the face. In some people, it becomes enlarged through genetics, frequent clenching or teeth grinding, which can make the lower face look broader or more square.

When this muscle is overactive, it can affect both comfort and facial shape, sometimes causing migranes. Carefully relaxing the masseter can help reduce jaw tension and, over time, soften the width of the lower face in suitable clients.
parentNamesRaw: Toxin for Jawline Slimming / Teeth Grinding

title: Treating the Masseter
body:
Masseter treatment uses carefully placed anti-wrinkle injections to relax an overactive jaw muscle. As the muscle stops working quite so hard, it can gradually reduce in bulk, helping to soften a square lower face and create a more refined jawline in suitable clients.

This is not instant contouring, and it is not about changing your face into someone else’s. The best results look like a subtle edit: less tension, less heaviness through the jaw, and a softer lower-face shape that still looks completely like you.
parentNamesRaw: Toxin for Jawline Slimming / Teeth Grinding

title: Who Is Masseter Treatment For?
body:
Masseter treatment may suit people who grind their teeth, clench their jaw, or carry tension through the lower face. Many clients search for this kind of help using phrases like TMJ, temporomandibular joint pain, teeth grinding treatment, jaw clenching treatment or masseter muscle treatment.

The important distinction is that the temporomandibular joint itself is the jaw joint, while the masseter is one of the powerful muscles that works around it. If your concern is mainly overactive muscle, jaw tension, clenching or a wider-looking lower face, carefully relaxing the masseter may help soften tension and reduce bulk over time.
parentNamesRaw: Toxin for Jawline Slimming / Teeth Grinding

title: Is It Muscle, Fat or Bone?
body:
A square or heavy-looking jaw is not always caused by the masseter muscle. Sometimes the width comes from bone structure, facial fullness, skin laxity or a higher level of body fat, which means masseter treatment may not give a dramatic slimming result.

That is why we assess you properly in clinic before prescribing treatment. We feel the muscle, look at how your jaw moves, and only recommend treatment if we believe it is genuinely likely to help.
parentNamesRaw: Toxin for Jawline Slimming / Teeth Grinding

title: Is Masseter Treatment Painful?
body:
Most clients find masseter treatment very easy. The area is not usually as sensitive as the lips or under-eyes, so numbing cream is not normally needed.

You may feel a tiny pinch or quick flick against the skin, but the needles we use are extremely fine and the treatment itself is fast. For most people, it is one of the easier injectable treatments to have done.
parentNamesRaw: Toxin for Jawline Slimming / Teeth Grinding

title: How Long Do Results Last?
body:
Masseter treatment is gradual. Jaw tension and clenching may start to feel easier after 3 weeks, while visible slimming usually takes longer because the muscle needs time to reduce in size.

Most clients notice the best change over several weeks, with results often lasting around three to six months. Some people choose maintenance appointments to keep the muscle relaxed and the lower face softer over time.
parentNamesRaw: Toxin for Jawline Slimming / Teeth Grinding
